name: pad occupancy time
definition: Aggregated approach and landing pad occupation
notes: Preis 2023 Table 1 and App. A.1 Eq. 3: 46.3 s airspace entry + 22.9 s final hover to touchdown + 5.0 s engine stop + 30.0 s separation after pad exit. Does not identify touchdown-to-exit duration (VAR-006).

name: declared charging time
definition: Service duration per turnaround; zero = no local charging
notes: Preis 2023 Table 1 and Secs. 3.1 and 3.3; VoloCity 2 seats and concurrent aircraft service/boarding in source. Author decision 2026-11-18 adopts 30 min baseline and 0/60 min variants without passengers during charging. LIT-008 Sec. 5.1.1.6.4 supports reservation, not values.

name: passenger load factor
definition: Occupied seats divided by available seats
notes: Preis 2023 Sec. 3.1 and Sec. 6 assumption; VAR-032 controls manifest demand. Not a no-show rate.

name: passenger arrival window
definition: Passenger arrival before scheduled departure
scenario_role: terminal queue scenario; window adopted in D4.1 v2.1 as PAR-054
notes: Feldhoff 2022 pp. 6-7 Table 2 and accompanying text; simulation arrival profile relative to STD. Not a late/no-show distribution.

name: counter check-in share
definition: Share of passengers using staffed counter
notes: Feldhoff 2022 p. 5 progressive scenario; channel mix not yet adopted.

name: kiosk check-in share
definition: Share of passengers using kiosk
notes: Feldhoff 2022 p. 5 progressive scenario; channel mix not yet adopted.

name: online check-in share
definition: Share of passengers arriving pre-checked-in
notes: Feldhoff 2022 p. 5 progressive scenario; channel mix not yet adopted.

name: boarding time
definition: Passenger boarding process duration
notes: Preis and Hornung 2022 Tables 3 and A1 (B3), point estimate adopted as constant 2026-11-18. Individual boarding event; timetable aggregation and overlap require explicit implementation.

name: deboarding time
definition: Passenger deboarding process duration
notes: Preis and Hornung 2022 Tables 3 and A1 (B4), point estimate adopted as constant 2026-11-18. Preserve individual event boundaries and document aggregation.

name: charging power
definition: Charging power available to an eVTOL
notes: Preis and Hornung 2022 Table 3. The adopted scenario takes declared duration (PAR-002); no conversion from power.

name: battery swap duration
definition: Duration of battery swapping
notes: Excluded from the study by author decision (2026-11-18). Kept for traceability: Preis and Hornung 2022 expert-based value.

name: gate service time
definition: Aircraft gate sequence including charge passenger process and buffer
notes: Park et al. 2022; aggregated gate service includes operations modelled as separate components in integrated D2; not an additional duration.

name: TLOF movement time
definition: Time assigned to one TLOF movement
notes: Park et al. 2022. Establish event-boundary equivalence before use; not adopted as VAR-006.

name: aircraft arrival rate
definition: Arrival intensity at the vertiport
notes: Park et al. 2022. Source scenario range, not observed demand or the experimental design.

name: FAA TLOF diameter
definition: Minimum touchdown and lift-off area dimension
notes: FAA EB 105A geometry requirement; not an operational service time.

name: FAA FATO diameter
definition: Minimum final approach and take-off area dimension
notes: FAA EB 105A geometry requirement.

name: FAA safety area
definition: Minimum safety area dimension
notes: FAA EB 105A geometry requirement.

name: EASA FATO diameter
definition: Minimum final approach and take-off area dimension
value_or_range: at least 1.5 D or AFM dimension
notes: EASA prototype technical specification; vehicle-specific AFM input required.

name: EASA stand envelope
definition: Stand diameter for eVTOL
notes: EASA prototype technical specification; applies to geometry. Stand service time comes from separately defined processes.

name: EASA air-taxi speed
definition: Maximum air-taxi route speed
notes: EASA prototype technical specification; translate to travel time only after route length is specified.

name: walk holding area to gate
definition: Walk from waiting area to gate door
notes: Preis and Hornung 2022 Table 3; 3 experts. Adopted as constant (author decision 2026-11-18): source gives point value only.

name: enter gate
definition: Door to aircraft proximity
notes: Preis and Hornung 2022 Table 3; 5 experts. Adopted as constant (author decision 2026-11-18): source gives point value only.

name: leave gate
definition: Aircraft proximity to terminal door after deboarding
notes: Preis and Hornung 2022 Table 3; 2 experts. Adopted as constant (author decision 2026-11-18): source gives point value only.

name: access control time
definition: Access control replacing full screening
notes: Feldhoff and Soares Roque 2021; stated assumption without citation. Not adopted: author chose full screening (2026-11-18).

name: station LoS maximum waiting times
definition: Maximum wait per station (counter; self-service; security)
notes: IATA ADRM first-class/fast-track Optimum maxima for counter; self-service; security as reproduced by Feldhoff 2022 Table 5; adopted (author decision 2026-11-18). LoS is not satisfaction.

name: peak DC charging power envelope
definition: Range of OEM-reported peak DC charging power
notes: NREL 2023 anonymised OEM survey; not Eve/Joby; do not convert to duration. Not used: charging time is declared (PAR-002), so power is not needed; a power range is not a probability distribution.

name: baggage check time
definition: Carry-on baggage check
notes: Feldhoff and Soares Roque 2021 section Vertiport simulation; assumption of the source authors. Mandatory step adopted 2026-11-18.

name: post-exit TLOF separation
definition: Time from vacating pad to eligibility for next operation
notes: Preis and Hornung 2022 Table 3 and Table A1 A4; scenario value, separate from VAR-006 physical occupation.

name: staffed low-cost check-in reference
definition: Airport scenario bounds for low-cost staffed check-in
notes: Felix 2015 Sec. 5.2.2 p. 54; author assumptions informed by field timings, with process scope specific to Lisbon. VAR-004 remains undefined.

name: alternative LoS waiting limits
definition: Maximum wait at counter, kiosk and security
distribution_or_rule: economy thresholds scaled by 0.167 in source
notes: Feldhoff 2022 Tab. 6 p. 9. Apply to same wait records. The adopted base remains PAR-026.

name: kiosk-only check-in reference
definition: Airport scenario bounds for kiosk check-in without tagging/drop
notes: Felix 2015 Sec. 5.2.2 p. 55; VAR-004 remains undefined.

name: security checkpoint event data
definition: Airport security lane process events, including linked passenger and baggage tasks
distribution_or_rule: study Tables 2 and 4 define recorded events and durations
notes: Janssen et al. 2020 Secs. 2-3. Checkpoint time embeds waits and overlaps; direct use as one server would require justified aggregation and transfer.

name: arrival rule for by-the-seat helicopter service
definition: Published arrival requirement for carrier-intermediated flights
scenario_role: mechanism precedent for incomplete flight groups
notes: BLADE general terms Sec. 5; arrival requirement and no obligation to wait. Not a boarding cutoff, a rate, or a rule of Eve/Joby.

name: active ground taxi speed
definition: Ground motion under own power
notes: Preis and Hornung 2022 Tab. 3 T4; five expert inputs and one literature input. Applicability to the aircraft must be established.

name: passive ground taxi speed
definition: Ground motion using an external device
notes: Preis and Hornung 2022 Tab. 3 T2; six expert inputs.

name: passive ground device mounting or removal
definition: Attach at origin or remove at destination, recorded as separate events
notes: Preis and Hornung 2022 Sec. 4.3.4, Tab. 3 T1/T3 and Tab. A1; three expert inputs. Count at occupied origin or destination as appropriate.

name: engine shutdown time
definition: Elapsed time from idle to engine off
scenario_role: VAR-006 if required by handling sequence
notes: Preis and Hornung 2022 Tab. 3 T7/A3 and Tab. A1; two expert inputs; covers only the defined shutdown event.

name: heliport ground taxi rule of thumb
definition: Ground taxi speed from interviews with heliport specialists
notes: Zelinski 2020 Sec. V.B; 1.2192 m/s is the unit conversion of an approximate value (about 1.22 m/s).

name: taxi speed in topology comparison
definition: Generic case taxi speed in DES topology study
notes: Wille 2024 Sec. 3.1; not observed and no manufacturer applicability inferred.

name: internal TLOF taxi distance
definition: Touchdown position to physical clearance of TLOF
notes: Approved 2026-11-19; project scenario distance, not aircraft D. LIT-003 supports the taxiing mode, not the distance.

name: shared ground taxi route distance
definition: Physical TLOF clearance to stand entry, reversed outbound
notes: Approved 2026-11-19; project scenario distance. LIT-034 supports the distance-based method, not this route length.

name: towed touchdown-to-exit duration
definition: Sequential idle-to-off plus tug attachment and taxi to physical clearance
distribution_or_rule: PAR-038 + PAR-037 + PAR-041/PAR-036 rounded to 0.1 s
notes: Approved 2026-11-19. Includes only the specified handling events; not measured or validated for Eve or Joby.

name: towed ground route travel duration
definition: Movement per leg on the shared taxi route
notes: Approved 2026-11-19. Excludes waiting and stand service; not measured or validated for Eve or Joby.

name: departure TLOF occupancy
definition: Physical TLOF entry until liftoff in C/D
notes: Includes handling at departure TLOF. Excludes inbound movement to TLOF and separation after liftoff. NASA simulated taxi-to-takeoff has different boundaries.

name: staffed counter service
definition: Start to end of staffed check-in
notes: Chosen to exercise the inclusive counter wait limit. Service and queue threshold are distinct.

name: full security service
definition: Start to end of full screening
notes: Single server with waits recorded separately.

name: trace post-exit separation
definition: Exit until availability after arrival or departure
notes: Independent of physical occupancy. No regulatory time attributed.

name: departure lateness tolerance
definition: Upper tolerance after requested departure
notes: Denominator is observed passenger liftoffs.

name: operating window
definition: Observation from empty opening
notes: Experimental assumption; see deliverables/D4_1_cenarios.md v2.

name: offered flight demand
definition: Poisson offers from 2700 s until closing
distribution_or_rule: 6 baseline; thin common 8/h stream with independent marks (<0.75 and <0.5)
notes: Author choice from estimated stand and counter loads; see deliverables/D4_1_cenarios.md v2.

name: reserved seats
definition: Common destination manifest size
notes: Experimental assumption; see deliverables/D4_1_cenarios.md v2.

name: absence probability
definition: Independent absence by reservation
notes: Experimental assumption; see deliverables/D4_1_cenarios.md v2.

name: arrival relative to STD
definition: Arrival of showing passengers before scheduled departure
distribution_or_rule: continuous uniform SUPPOSED; source uses beta without reported parameters
notes: Window from Feldhoff 2022 p. 6 (IATA daytime profile compressed to 15-60 min before STD; PAR-004). Uniform shape is an explicit assumption: beta parameters not published and IATA ADRM 9th ed. (source Ref. [46]) not found in open access on 2026-11-23; see deliverables/D4_1_cenarios.md v2.

name: arrival window width
definition: Latest touchdown start after request, for both policies
distribution_or_rule: inclusive; agenda: earliest feasible slot or refusal; FCFS: divert if arrival cannot start by request + 300 s
notes: Experimental assumption; see deliverables/D4_1_cenarios.md v2.

name: scheduled departure offset
definition: STD minus aircraft request time
distribution_or_rule: rule; fixed slack across charging families
notes: 900 s is an author choice (manifest close then equals request + charge; estimated slack about 340 s for mean group); linking to charge avoids trivially late flights; see deliverables/D4_1_cenarios.md v2.

name: parking positions
definition: Stands, each with own charger and passenger gate
distribution_or_rule: one TLOF and one shared route; equal taxi times SUPPOSED
notes: Feldhoff 2022 p. 5 topology 1 FATO + 5 stands from Ref. [8] (LIT-009), derived there for 300 s turnaround: topology adopted, efficiency not transferred. Charger and gate per stand SUPPOSED; see deliverables/D4_1_cenarios.md v2.

name: baseline baggage forecast
definition: Planning forecast for service not yet started
distribution_or_rule: mean of PAR-028; exact individual duration in information sensitivity
notes: Experimental assumption; see deliverables/D4_1_cenarios.md v2.

name: manifest close
definition: Manifest closing relative to STD
distribution_or_rule: constant; equals tmin of arrival window
notes: Feldhoff 2022 p. 6 tmin 15 min (Voom, source Ref. [47]); BLADE 15 min arrival requirement (PAR-034) is a precedent, not a boarding cutoff; see deliverables/D4_1_cenarios.md v2.

name: check-in counters
definition: Parallel staffed counter servers with single FCFS queue
notes: Feldhoff 2022 p. 10 compares one and two counters and identifies the counter as bottleneck; see deliverables/D4_1_cenarios.md v2.

name: security screening posts
definition: Parallel full screening servers with single FCFS queue
notes: D3 hypothesis on an additional screening post; Feldhoff 2022 p. 10 found no security waits above LoS; see deliverables/D4_1_cenarios.md v2.

name: refusal communication
definition: Instant and effect of refusal (agenda) or diversion (FCFS) on reserved passengers
distribution_or_rule: not yet arrived: no show; in service: finish and leave; in queue or lounge: leave
notes: Makes terminal load depend on admission policy; see deliverables/D4_1_cenarios.md v2.

name: service-time variability bound
definition: Check-in and security service durations drawn per passenger from exponential distributions with the declared means (180 s; 90 s)
distribution_or_rule: inverse-CDF draws from per-passenger uniforms generated before any policy
notes: SUPPOSED classical upper-variability benchmark (coefficient of variation 1) bracketing the deterministic base (coefficient of variation 0). Janssen et al. 2020 (LIT-030) report security mean times by passenger type (162-207 s) without dispersion in the text; raw data not analysed.
